items.summary: We present EmbeddingGemma 2, an open multimodal embedding model which natively represents text, images, audio, video, and combinations thereof in a unified space. items.title: Quiz: How to Use Generators and yield in Python
items.description: In this quiz, you'll test your understanding of Python generators and the yield statement. With this knowledge, you'll be able to work with large datasets in a more Pythonic fashion, create generator functions and expressions, and build data pipelines.
items.summary: In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of Python generators . Generators and the Python yield statement can help you when you’re working with large datasets that might overwhelm your machine’s memory.
